title: My mini photo setup (a whole second hobby)

images.alt: A Canon Rebel on a tripod, tethered by cable, aimed at a small glowing lightbox of painted minis on a wooden shelf; the rear screen shows manual mode, f/32, 0.3 seconds, ISO 200
Over-the-shoulder view of the Canon Rebel at the painting desk, a Blood Bowl knight on a painting handle between two small LED lights, wall paint racks behind and the mini on the camera's rear screen
The resulting shot: Holy Hand Grenadiers knight number 1 on a painting handle, gold sunburst halo, slate blue armor and red tabard, paint racks melted into a soft blur behind
